# Pharmacy: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Prescription medicines must only be released after a pharmacist has checked the order, per the Pharmacy Standards 5. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a pharmacist, I want to check each prescription order before it is handed over so that nothing unsafe leaves. Acceptance: the pickup button stays locked until a pharmacist has approved.
US-2 As a customer, I want a text when my order is ready so that I know when to collect.
US-3 As a customer, I want to reorder a repeat prescription so that I do not queue.
